slash_arc.doc: A slash arc of reach {r} (tenths) about the executor (S3: the body + 1.4 / 1.8, rotated as the body; S2: the blade anchor): {yaw} / {pitch} offsets of the aim from the executor rotation, {roll} the blade plane about the aim (0 horizontal, 90 vertical, 180 backhand: the sweep reversed). Four sweep frames 1 tick apart (the last fades over 8 t), c 1 orange-gold flame / c 2 crimson with black smoke; particles at the arc front. An arc that would reach below the floor rises up to 1 b, then shrinks (fx/e/clamp_arc): no frame goes below the floor.

spin_ring.doc: A full ring of flame of radius {r} (tenths) about the executor (S3: the body + 1.0; S2: her feet, the intro floor ring), lifted 0.3 b: two counter-turning rings, embers thrown out; c 1 orange-gold, c 2 crimson with smoke.

twirl_ring.doc: Intro E6 (S2: at the hand anchor, rotated as the body): the crimson crescent trail closing into a full ring in the frontal plane (radius 1.3 b, less when the hand is low: the ring never reaches the floor), an orange inner ring, crimson sparks.

scythe_form.doc: The crimson flame vortex where a scythe forms (S2 intro E3 / T twin scythes, S3 B wheel spin: at the palm / hand anchor or the body + 1.4): six crimson flame tongues stream in to the point, a glow, crimson sparks and smoke.

embers_puff.doc: A small puff of red-orange embers at the executor (anchors, the body + 1.4: the cup to embers, the reach, the stance, her heal): six embers flung out, a soft glow, ash.

wheel_trail.doc: The fire trail the thrown wheel leaves on the ground (B release: the body at the floor, rotated as the body): eight flame tongues along the aim over {len} (tenths), each lit as the wheel passes it (1.5 b / t), burning out over 18 t (vertical cards standing on the floor, no floor decal).

dash_trail.doc: The streak of a dash along the aim over {len} (tenths) from the executor (S3: the body + 1.0, rotated as the body): a wide outer streak and a white-hot inner one at hip height, four flame tongues revealed in turn at the feet, colour particles; c 1 orange-gold, c 2 crimson.

leap_flare.doc: The take-off flare (C / E leaps, T launch: the body + 0.3 / + 1.4): a flaming ring bursting out, a flash, embers rising.

dive_streak.doc: The dive streak (C / E dives, Q0 fall: the body + 1, rotated as the body): a streak from the executor down-forward (50 deg) over {len} (tenths), clamped to end above the floor: a crimson outer streak and an orange-gold core, sparks at the executor.

impact_burst.doc: A blade landing (S3: the floor point + 0.2, the lock marker): a shock ring of radius {r} (tenths) at 0.3 b, a flash, embers low; c 2 adds crimson thorn shards and smoke.

claw.doc: B2 grab (S3: the lock + 1 at pt 92, the hit at 96): the crimson claw closing over 4 t to the reach {r} (tenths), white-hot at the close, then a crimson burst.

wing_burst.doc: The crimson wings burst open (C2 / H / E70 / F: the body + 1.4, rotated as the body): crimson feathers flung back and out, black smoke, crimson dust.

zig_streak.doc: An E lateral dash (S3: the body + 1.2, rotated as the body, at each dash): a red-orange streak of {len} (tenths) across her, centred on her (the dash goes either way), sparks at both ends.

brand_ring.doc: The crimson sigil closing on the player (F / Q5 pt 6 -> brand 22: at the player's feet): two sigil rings at 0.5 b and 1.3 b (on the player, not a floor marking) contract from r 3.2 to 0.5 over 16 t, turning, white-hot at the close.

brand_x.doc: The forced bond lands (bond/force: the player + 1): a red X branded on the player (two strokes), a red flash, crimson sparks.

threads.doc: Crimson threads from the sky (F hit 1: the arena centre + 0.2, r = the walk; H leap: the body + 3, r 10): up to 14 threads (0.6 b wide cards) at fixed points inside radius {r} (tenths; 4 below r 60), drawn down from 12 b to the executor's height in 3 t (vertical cards, never below the executor), fading after 14 t.

thorns.doc: Crimson thorns erupting from the floor (F hit 1, G field: the arena centre on the floor, r = the walk): up to 16 thorns at fixed points inside radius {r} (tenths; 6 below r 60), rising 2.3-3.8 b in 2 t from the floor (vertical cards standing on it), crimson chips and smoke.

blast.doc: F hit 2 / G field (the arena centre on the floor, r = the walk): a crimson blast over radius {r} (tenths): a huge glow, a shock ring at 0.6 b to the full radius, smoke thrown out, explosions across the floor.

web.doc: H perch (S3: the body + 0.5, perched 7 b up): the crimson web spreads under her (4 b), turning slowly, for 56 t.

clone_trail.doc: A clone's afterimage (at / rotated as a clone prop: its facing is its flight): a crimson streak behind it, smoke, crimson dust.

blade_rise.doc: G a giant blade rises (at each blade prop, on the floor): a crimson glow at its base, crimson chips and two small thorns beside it.

blade_burst.doc: G the blades strike (at each blade prop + 1): crimson shards flung out, a flash, smoke.

cross_thorns.doc: G a cross line erupts, one thorn per call (at its floor point on the line, the module calls 12 a tick along the four arms, each only on the walk disc): a crimson thorn rising to {h} (tenths) in 2 t from the tick after the call, crimson chips and dust.

shock_gain.doc: 선혈의 충격 armed (bond/cleared: the player + 1): crimson and gold embers spiral up around the player, a crimson glow pulse, sparkles.

shock_aura.doc: The crimson glow on her palm (B2 reach: at the hand anchor): a pulsing crimson glow for 20 t, crimson dust.

shock_hit.doc: 선혈의 충격 outside a break window (bond/burst: the body + 1.4): a crimson burst, a ring, sparks.

break_burst.doc: The Banquet broken (core/break: the body + 1.4): a big crimson shatter: burst, two rings, crimson shards flung out like glass, smoke, a flash.

stun_motes.doc: The stun (core/stun_fx every 10 t: the body + 2.9): three small crimson-gold motes circling over her head for one call (11 t), at a random start angle, little crits.

pillar.doc: The crimson flame column of T (S2: her feet; pillar 24 r 12, swap 90 r 16): two crossed column cards of radius {r} (tenths), 6 b tall, rising from her feet over 10 t, burning 66 t; crimson flame dust, smoke at the top.

shroud.doc: T the form swap is hidden (S2: her feet, rotated as the body, 8 t before the swap; she hangs 1.3-3 b up, her forearms up to 1.2 b out): a cocoon of crimson flame veils closes round her in 3 t (4 rings of 10 at r 1.35, 1.1-4.25 b up, facing the viewer, none below the floor) with flame tongues licking up it; the rings burn away one by one from the bottom (fading 13-29 t after it starts) while she rises out of the top in her new form.

shroud_burst.doc: T the swap itself (S2: the chest anchor at the swap tick): a white-hot flash inside the cocoon, a crimson glow, crimson blade shards flung out all round (as in the footage), a flash.

legs_burst.doc: T: a pair of blade legs unfolds (S2: the spine anchor, rotated as the body): crimson feathers and ash flung out sideways and back, a crimson glow.

moon_flare.doc: The red moon flares (Q6 moon: at the halo / her): the halo swelling and fading over 20 t, a big crimson glow, crimson dust.

aim_line.doc: Q4 aim (at the chest anchor, rotated toward the player, pitch counts; call every tick or every 2 t while it tracks): a thin red line over {len} (tenths), 3 t.

reticle.doc: Q4 the reticle growing at her chest (at the chest anchor, rotated toward the player): the red reticle 0.6 b ahead grows over 18 t, turning, white-hot from 20 t (the lock), gone at 26 t.

beam.doc: Q4 the beam (at the chest anchor, rotated toward the locked point, pitch counts): a crimson beam over {len} (tenths) swelling to 2.2 b in 2 t, a white core, a flash at the origin, crimson dust along it; 10 t.

x_mark.doc: Q5B the vertical red X carved in front of her (at her feet, rotated toward the player): two strokes 4.6 b long crossing 1.6 b ahead, 2.3 b up (never below 0.4 b), the second 12 t after the first, each carved in 10 t; held 72 t (to the final), white-hot from 64.

rapid_slash.doc: Q5B one rapid slash (S4: per slash, the body + 1.2): two flat crimson arcs of reach 5.5 b at random bearings (roll within +-10 deg: they stay above the floor), 3 t each.

final_burst.doc: A big crimson flame burst of radius {r} (tenths) at the executor (Q5B final: her feet; death gone: her feet, r 20): a flash, a shock ring at 0.4 b, crimson flames flung out low, smoke, explosions.

feather_hit.doc: Q6 a feather bolt lands (its landing point on the floor): a small crimson ring at 0.3 b, a flash, three small thorns, crimson chips.

orb_gather.doc: Q6 110: eight crimson orbs gather around her (the body): orbs flying in from 4 b to 1.6 b at 1.5 b up, a crimson glow at her.

orb_burst.doc: Q6 an orb explodes (at the orb on the floor): a crimson ring of radius {r} (tenths) at 0.3 b, a glow, four thorns, smoke.

death_flames.doc: Death 70: crimson flames climb her body (her feet): ten flame tongues from the feet to 2.5 b over 24 t, smoke, crimson dust.

wisp_turn.doc: A wisp turns colour (as / at a wisp: its display, or the marker a wisp prop follows): c 2 red, c 1 white again; a puff in the new colour.

gate_flames.doc: Crimson flames on the entrance gravestone (S3 gate/flames every 10 t: at the stone's flame point): two flame tongues, crimson spores. Ambient: skipped from SOFT live fx cards.

ambient_petals.doc: Arena ambience (the module, every ~10 t; at the arena centre): crimson embers and spores drifting down through the plaza (particles only). Ambient: skipped from SOFT live fx cards.

wheel.doc: B / Q2 flaming scythe wheel: one face card 2.3 b across facing its flight (the display's rotation), the four spin frames turned every tick by the kit.

crescent.doc: P2 thrown flame crescent: one face card 2.8 b wide facing its flight.

feather.doc: Q6 crimson feather bolt: one face card 0.7 x 1.4 b facing its flight, tip toward the display's local -y.

orb.doc: Q6 crimson orb: one card 1.2 b, always facing the viewer (an orb is round).

blade.doc: G giant crimson blade: one card 1.4 x 5.6 b standing on the display (its base at the display, never below it), turning about the vertical to face the viewer.

clone.doc: H crimson shadow clone: one face card 1.3 x 2.6 b, feet at the display, facing the display's yaw (its flight).

wisp.doc: A flame spirit {c} (1 white, 2 red): one card 0.7 b facing the viewer, three flicker frames and a slow bob by the kit.

moon_halo.doc: The red-moon halo: one card 7 b facing the viewer.

flood.doc: F the red flood {r, t}: one crimson wash disc of radius r spreading from the centre over min(t - 6, 44) ticks; DECAL_FLASH ticks before t a bright overlay flashes on until the hit; it stays 14 t after t. A second call while it is shown re-times it (no second disc): it stays to the new t + 14 and flashes again.

cracks.doc: F the cracks {r}: glowing crimson cracks over radius r, 36 t (cosmetic), dimming after 22 t.

strip.doc: G a strip {len, w, yaw, t}: a translucent red band len x w centred on the executor along the absolute yaw, drawn out along its length in 6 t, bright from t - 6, gone at t + 3.

rim_tint.doc: G the rim tint {r0, r, t}: nested red annuli appear from radius r inward to r0 by t - 6 (the floor reddening inside the blade ring), bright from t - 6, gone at t + 3.

pool.doc: E70 the red pool {r, t} (cosmetic): a darker crimson disc spreading to r by t - 6, bright from t - 6, lingering 20 t after t.

ring_o.doc: Q5A a ring outline {r, t}: a thin red circle of radius r (outline only), bright from t - 6, gone at t + 3.

donut_o.doc: Q5A a donut outline {r0, r, t}: the two circles r0 and r, bright from t - 6, gone at t + 3.

tea_sip.use: E0 t16: she sips the tea.

wisp_chime.use: E0 t4 / t20: the white flame spirits.

cup_embers.use: E1 t34: cup and saucer burst into embers.

wisps_flee.use: E1 t35: the spirits flee to the rim posts.

ember_reach.use: E2 t44: crimson embers stream into her palm.

scythe_vortex.use: E3 t52: the crimson flame vortex.

scythe_form.use: E4 t62: the haft grows out of the palm.

twirl_ring.use: E6 t96 / t98: the ring closes, the floor ring.

flip.use: E8 t112: the scythe rolls through the hand.

t_stagger.use: T 0: she staggers to one knee.

t_swap.use: T 90: the form swap inside the pillar.

t_legs.use: T 110 / 116 / 122: a pair of blade legs unfolds.

t_launch.use: T 150: she launches up and away.

death_gone.use: Death 96: she vanishes in a flame burst.

spin.use: A h3 / h5, Q1 h1 spin rings.

wheel_spin.use: B 10: the scythe spins into a wheel.

claw_reach.use: B2 76: the reach, crimson glow on the palm.

brand.use: Forced bond: the sigil closes, the brand.

flood.use: F / E70: the red flood / pool spreads.

blast.use: F hit 2 / G field: the blast.

blade_fly.use: G the blades fly in along the cross lines.

orbs_toss.use: Q6 125: the orbs fly to the rim.

banner.text: 생명의 계약을 제거하고 일반 공격으로 「붉은 피의 연회」를 중단시키세요
banner.component: {text:"",extra:[{text:"생명의 계약을 제거하고 일반 공격",color:"#F07858"},{text:"으로 「붉은 피의 연회」를 중단시키세요",color:"#FFFFFF"}]}

1.text: 두려운가? 아니면 두려워할 용기조차 없는 건가?

5.text: 힘 뺄 거 없어. 도망칠 수 없을 테니.

9.text: 도망치기 바쁜 꼴이 가엾게 떠는 짐승 같구나.

12.text: 이제 네 본심을 볼 수 있겠군.

14.text: 일몰은 그저, 모든 것의 시작일 뿐.

15.text: 해와 달은 결국 지고 파멸은 계속해서 찾아오지!
